entries.title: On “Derek,” Captain Ahab’s Evil Half Brother
entries.summary: “Your worst enemy ain’t Moby Dick, it’s your half brother, Derek.”

entries.title: My Larval Roommates
entries.summary: “When holes appeared in my underwear, I knew that I had a case of moths.”

entries.title: On the “Chattanooga Choo Choo”
entries.summary: “Lately, though, I have become fascinated by the so-called big bands on the SiriusXM station called ‘40s Junction.’ ”
